Shallow validation lets a valid-JSON file like {\"lastId\":1,\"todos\":[null]} crash list with a raw TypeError stack trace, and every I/O error (missing directory, TODO_FILE pointing at a directory) dumps an uncaught Node stack trace. A strict reviewer weighs those defects in the error path above its better docs and test layout, which puts Z last.
